inputs.allowed: facial identity, adult age, curly updo, star-tiara identity, warm direct expression, silver wand
inputs.excluded: rendering, clothing material, lighting, palette, glossy finish

method.mobile_proof: center crop to 3:2, resized to 390x260 with macOS sips
method.prompt: Create one new LAiDIES Homepage illustration for the FG-INTENT-HELP job. IMAGE 1 CONTROLS IDENTITY ONLY: preserve this exact adult Black FAiRY facial identity, adult age, curly updo, small star-tiara identity, warm direct expression, and silver wand. Explicitly ignore Image 1's glossy rendering, velvet/plum robe, gold-star repetition, soft lighting, painterly finish, and palette. IMAGES 2–5 ARE THE MANDATORY RENDERING AUTHORITY. Scene: FAiRY works at a late-1990s desk. A visibly rough draft page with abstract crossed-out lines and simple diagram marks lies on the desk; a period translucent CRT computer sits nearby. The image must communicate prompt/help through action and composition, without readable text or UI. She feels warm, capable, sophisticated, adult, and legitimate. Rendering: unequivocally 2D hand-inked adult editorial graphic novel. Decisive thick-to-thin black ink contours; angular faceted local-colour planes; flat editorial value structure; hard cel shadows; crisp edges at face, hands, wand, computer and draft; disciplined pop-art composition; selective restrained halftone only where it supports form. Skin, clothing, furniture and background must be built from hard-edged colour shapes, not soft modelling. This must not look like polished fantasy concept art or an AI fantasy painting. Palette: deep navy, electric cyan/teal, hot pink, coral and restrained warm neutrals. Plum/purple may appear only as one minor identity accent. Gold may appear only in tiny tiara/wand/star accents. Outfit is sharp late-1990s editorial tailoring in navy/teal/coral, never a plush robe. Composition: 3:2 landscape. FAiRY occupies the right two-fifths; desk, CRT computer and rough draft establish the left side. Keep the essential face, hands, wand, draft and computer readable in a centered 390x260 crop. One character only. Luminous dusk atmosphere translated into hard graphic colour planes. Do not include readable generated text, speech bubbles, logos, UI labels, watermarks, mystery controls, extra fingers, or broken anatomy. Avoid airbrushed skin, glossy sheen, velvet, soft gradients, photorealism, 3D rendering, painterly brushwork, glamour cartoon, stickers, candy styling, grunge, white/cream shell, or a purple-and-gold governing system.

observations: FAiRY identity, adult age, curly updo, small star tiara, warm expression and silver wand are visibly preserved.
Rendering is governed by hard ink contours, faceted local-colour planes and flat editorial values rather than the identity plate's glossy fantasy treatment.
Navy, cyan/teal, hot pink and coral govern the palette; gold is restricted to small identity accents.
The late-1990s CRT, rough draft and active writing pose communicate the prompt-help job without readable generated text.
The 390x260 crop retains face, hands, wand, CRT and rough draft.
maker_inspection.authority: Maker observations only; independent all-floor PASS is required.
